title: nicw-1996-world-heavyweight
label: "Masta Ace" Mike D'Angelo

won.source: The fed's own 'NICW Wrestlefest - RSP-WF Edition' broadcast: D'Angelo won the deciding fall with a Claw Hold submission.

how: Defeated three-time champion Falcon two falls to one in a thirty-minute Ironman match.
note: No further NICW document in the held record records a title change after this win.

title: nicw-1996-world-heavyweight
label: Falcon

won.source: Billed a three-time former champion in the fed's own Wrestlefest broadcast; no title-change document for any of his three reigns survives in the held record.

how: Not recovered — held the title coming into the held record.
note: Lost the title to Mike D'Angelo on 23 May 1996.

title: nicw-1996-world-heavyweight
label: "The Unforgiven" David Pietka

won.source: Billed the NICW World Heavyweight Champion (6-0-0) in the promotion's own "NICW Official Rankings" (21 April 1999); no originating title-change document survives in the held record.

how: Recorded from the promotion's own repeated billing; the title-winning match itself is not attested.
note: Still champion at the close of the held record's 1999 pull.
